strategy: Freeze the exact failing test command before editing again.
Cluster failures by stable signature and assertion diff before choosing a fix.
Distinguish repeated same-signature failure from new regression failure.
Make one minimal code change per cycle and preserve existing passing cases.
Rerun the narrow failing test before broad suites.
Do not mark the task complete until final green test evidence is recorded.
summary: Codex-style AI coding recovery discipline for repeated test failures, failing assertions, regression loops, stale context, and missing final green test evidence.
